title: Why Did It Fly? First Law Explained Simply | PUC Physics Class 11
description:
Aarav brakes his bicycle hard at the college gate. The bicycle stops, but the water bottle in his basket flies forward. Nothing pushed it forward, so why did it move? In this animated lesson for PUC and Class 11 Physics (NCERT Chapter 4, Laws of Motion) we learn Newton's first law and what it really says about net force.

On a live motion notebook a 2 kg block slides at 4 m/s while friction is turned down from 0.4 to zero, and its velocity-time graph flattens into a straight line. A slow-mo replay shows the weight and the normal force cancelling. We build the law step by step (net force zero, so acceleration zero, so velocity constant, with rest as a special case), then explain link by link why passengers lurch forward when a bus brakes and fall back when it starts. Two pause-and-think questions, a worked example on a car at steady speed, the exam trap about zero net force, an original JEE Main pattern question with a full solution, a recap card and three questions to check yourself.

Made for PUC (Karnataka), CBSE Class 11, JEE Main and NEET students.
